chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى جَمِيلٌ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ:

translations.en: Jamil narrated from Zurarah, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ اشْتَرَى تِبْنَ بَيْدَرٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدَاسَ تِبْنَ كُلِّ كُرٍّ بِشَيْءٍ مَعْلُومٍ

translations.en: I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who purchased straw from a threshing floor before it was threshed, each kurr of straw for a specified amount,

chunks.arabic_text: فَيَأْخُذُ التِّبْنَ وَ يَبِيعُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُكَالَ الطَّعَامُ

translations.en: then he takes the straw and sells it before the grain is measured.
He عليه السلام said: “There is no harm in it.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the sale of straw from a threshing floor before the grain has been measured. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام rules that there is no harm in taking and reselling the straw in this case, indicating permissibility in this form of transaction.
en.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy and resell straw before the grain is measured?

key_terms.تِبْنَ: straw being bought and sold in the transaction
key_terms.بَيْدَرٍ: a threshing floor or harvested pile from which the straw is purchased
key_terms.كُرٍّ: a measured load or quantity used here in pricing the straw
key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ مَعْلُومٍ: for a specified and known amount
key_terms.الطَّعَامُ: the grain or food produce associated with the threshing
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
